title: Traditional Song of the Highlands No. 63 (Rwai Lum bad Wah Vol. 9)
khasi_title: Rwai Lum bad Wah Ba-paka No. 63
cultural_context: Laments tragic legends and honors sacred rivers, peaks, and monoliths. Passed down orally through generations of Khasi and Pnar families across Meghalaya.
lyrics_khasi:
Ynda wan ka por ba bet ia u kba,
Ki nongrep ki kmen ban trei;
Na sngi sha sngi da ka jinghok,
Ban bsa ia la ka kur ka jait.
lyrics_english:
When the season of paddy sowing arrives,
The cultivators joyfully till the fertile earth;
From sunrise to sunset in righteousness,
To nourish and sustain their matrilineal clan.
